findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. `seed` places a raw time record before `forge:end`. When an older PR has no `## How it went` section, `close._refresh_record` inserts a new history section after that marker (`time_records.py:658-663`), leaving two records. `time_records.from_body` reads only the first (`time_records.py:451-455`), so teammates cannot see local events and timings merged into the second. Backfill still clears the retry marker. The upgrade test uses bodies of this shape but gives those items no local logs.
findings.title: Not done: backfill shares the merged history on PR bodies without a history section

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. `people()` reads `started_by` only from a raw `item started` event. Once a record exceeds the 20 KB budget, `time_records._compact` folds the oldest events into a summary that retains no actor (`time_records.py:524-568, 572-593`). For a squashed item whose branch was deleted, `board._starters` cannot recover the original start commit from named refs (`board.py:958-969`), so the board loses the starter even though backfill fetched that commit. The added fixture never reaches compaction.
